mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months signals aggressive monetary easing that compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS remains below 0.5% for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and rise in CPIAUCSL above 2.0% signals inflationary pressure triggering policy uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.0%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls signals labor market strength that boosts corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS rises, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansions, a decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) relative to GDP (GDPC1) signals weakening consumer demand, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where RSAFS/GDPC1 ratio declines during late-cycle expansions, or ratio signal Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate profitability, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) exceed 1.2 million units annually for 3 consecutive months, it signals robust consumer spending that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1.2 million units for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of triggered periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During labor market tightness (UNRATE < 4.5%), a decline in unemployment rate below 4.0% signals overheating that may trigger aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE falls below 4.0% during labor market tightness, or Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate combined with rising consumer inflation (CPIAUCSL > 2.5%) signals policy uncertainty that depresses equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL > 2.5%, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.
